names: the fixture cities carry the classes this file asserts (so a rebuilt table cannot silently move the ground)
FALSIFIER 1 (the dispatch's Short-circuit): a no-ruled-table city's two parcels get DIFFERENT answers -- the branch reads the zoning rail before it decides
FALSIFIER 2a -- class (a): a district-less parcel is a declared refusal naming the city and P-364; never a value, never an absence
FALSIFIER 2a-precedence -- a class (a) parcel whose zoning rail ALREADY says not-applicable keeps that answer
FALSIFIER 2a-parity -- class (a) with a district on file is a DISTRICT miss, not a zoning-not-acquired refusal
FALSIFIER 2b -- class (b): the jurisdiction-default row ships as a VALUE with OT-10's disclosure
FALSIFIER 2b-parity -- class (b) with a district on file is a district miss, NEVER the default
FALSIFIER 2b-unusable -- class (b) whose row is not coded yet stays unaccounted and is COUNTED as such
FALSIFIER 2c -- class (c): the one earned absence, carrying the ordinance read that earns it
FALSIFIER 2c-parity -- class (c) with a district on file gets the district miss, not an absence
FALSIFIER 2null -- an unclassified city is NEVER guessed into a class
FALSIFIER 3 -- the jurisdiction-default row is reachable ONLY through its own entry point: no district code can ever map to it
FALSIFIER 3-corpus -- the row the writer serves carries the fields OT-10 requires
FALSIFIER 4 -- assertNoFalseAbsence admits the class (c) shape and refuses every lookalike
